title: Attachments tab offers a member neither Delete nor Rename on their own upload, though both server doors admit the uploader
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from PR #36458 (card #35724), L1-e ACCEPT 7080423901 landing condition. Filed by the seat.

## What happens

On a record's Attachments tab, a plain member who uploaded a file sees neither Delete nor Rename on their own upload. The panel gates Delete (and so Rename, which requires it) on the `sys_attachment` delete grant, and the member grant is read and create only (`attachment-member-grant.ts`, around line 66). The server admits the uploader on both doors regardless: the removal door since #33010, and the rename door from PR #36458. So the member can do it through the API but the console never offers it.

This is the console half named in the attachment removal ledger.

## What should happen

The uploader sees Delete and Rename on their own upload, the same rule the two server doors apply. A member who did not upload the file still sees neither, unless their grants allow it.

## Done when

- As a plain member: upload a file, then Delete and Rename are offered on it and both succeed.
- On another member's upload: neither is offered.
- Pinned in the panel's tests for both cases.
